issue.title: JWT - Use parameterized logging

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
Switches existing log statements to use parameterized log messages.

Performing string concatenation (e.g. "Value is [" + value + "]") for
a debug message incurs a runtime performance penalty, even though the
message itself is never written to any output (because debugging is
typically disabled).
The use of parameterized messages avoids the message formatting cost
if the output is never required.

In some cases messages have been wrapped in lambdas or
`isDebugEanbled` checks to avoid potentially expensive parameter
generation calls.

body: Thanks for raising this Tim. Luckily the search API has not been release yet. I'll fix it along with a few other adjustments to the API earlier next week.
